controls_limits: Invented engineering controls only. Inert dependencies are explicit; no real environment, actual data, target/header/model/key, backend, provider, container, native library, scientific operation or scientific qualification. Logical extents/reservations do not certify Python RSS, OS I/O or external-library allocation.
extent_derivation: Native conversion uses one invented interval and three target positions; no reader, HDF5, filesystem original or torch-brain operation occurs. Actual iter_windows composes inert interval/sampler capability doubles.

Feature controls use two units by50 bins and at most three requested times; all explicit/derived arrays, float masks and copies fit conservatively within512KiB per invocation, at most four invocations.

Ragged weighted-score/scaler/order controls use at most six target positions, two animals/three sessions, and at most four source feature rows; under1MiB combined including repeated encodings. No bootstrap, whole model fit or catalogue replay.

Metadata tests use actual repaired source functions with tiny invented dictionaries, canonical bodies and bounded failure mutations; no body larger than16KiB, no unbounded loop. Combined4MiB reservation covers repeated encode/parse/copy and journal publication.

Journal tests use an inert memory-backed os.write/fsync capability and actual Journal/PanelBudget/Budget methods, event cap4096 and fewer than24 events; reservations, emitted bytes, repeated readbacks and failed attempts included. No real process or provider call.
One8MiB reservation is retained in full even if observed bodies are smaller or the attempt fails. No retry is authorized by this reservation. Runtime/source code reads count separately.
